fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/hay-canyon-campground (Fee Site and Info '$10 per night'; last updated May 12, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Not on recreation.gov. The forest states that all Helena-Lewis and Clark NF campgrounds are first-come, first-served with a 16-day stay limit; fees are paid on site.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/hay-canyon-campground ('Please limit your stay to 16 days.') + the forest-wide statement on https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/grasshopper-campground ('All Helena-Lewis and Clark National Forest campgrounds are first-come, first-served with a 16-day stay limit. Fees are required and must be paid on-site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 30 ft is the maximum RECOMMENDED trailer length.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/hay-canyon-campground ('There are 7 campsites', 'The maximum recommended trailer length for the area is 30 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'No water year round.' Mandatory food storage (bears).

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/hay-canyon-campground (Current Conditions 'No water year round'; Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; 'Mandatory food storage is required.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Helena-Lewis & Clark NF campground in the Little Belt Mountains near fishing access on the South Fork of the Judith River and scenic ATV trails: from Utica, 17 miles southwest on a gravel county road. Bear country. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated May 12, 2026) confirms $10, 7 sites, 30-ft recommended trailer max, vault toilets, no water; added 16-day limit. Changed booking (inherited reservable/recreation.gov/180-day window) -> not reservable, FCFS, per the forest's statement that all H-LC campgrounds are FCFS (no rec.gov facility found).
